decisions.reason: The message defines where current production clips are submitted for audit; it does not change the qualification method, success condition, clip count, or deadline.
Sending a Google Drive link through project chat changes submission routing but leaves the client's approval authority, publication eligibility, and rejected-clip handling unchanged.
The submission-channel instruction does not change or resume the deferred monthly quota, its counting rule, or its output cadence.
The clip submission and audit channels do not change the Lead Clipper pathway, compensation, training focus, or assignment status.
The message addresses delivery and future submission tooling, not editing style, visual effects, transitions, or the standard's scope.
Submitting clips for audit through project chat does not change which clips may be published, the Instagram destination, or the current publication schedule.
Google Drive is specified as the delivery container, not as a new content source; permitted source footage and video-selection constraints remain unchanged.
The submission workflow does not alter the requirement that each clip contain a complete, understandable, standalone teaching moment.
The source message concerns where completed clips are delivered and does not modify the standard for selecting strong source moments.
The delivery-channel decision has no necessary effect on caption color, font, effects, or scope.
The source establishes submission and review-link channels only; it does not change the required 45-to-60-second clip duration.
